column1: # Known differences between the parser (Concrete/Frontend/Parser.lean) and grammar/concrete.ebnf,
# held by scripts/tests/check_grammar_conformance.sh. A difference is a SIGNATURE:
#   accept-gap <parser message>   the grammar derives the program; the parser refuses it
#   reject-gap <rule>: <token>    the grammar refuses the program (the reference recognizer got
#                                 furthest in <rule> and stopped at <token>); the parser accepts it
# The gate fails on a signature that is not listed, and on a listed one that no longer occurs:
# the list only shrinks. Removing a row is either a parser fix (a bug, ruled `Violates: SYN-1@1`)
# or a grammar edit, which the owner reviews. Nothing here changes either.
#   grammar stale            the grammar spells syntax the language has replaced
#   grammar wider            the parser enforces a rule the grammar does not state
#   LL(1) conflict           a FIRST/FOLLOW conflict that the parser resolves one way
#   parser accepts           the parser takes a form the grammar refuses: a SYN-1 bug unless the
#   parser refuses           the parser refuses a grammar form: a SYN-1 bug unless the grammar is
